preamble: All clues are normal. At ten intersections (squares at which across and down answers meet or cross each other) it will be found that the relevant letters of the two answers do not tally. In each case solvers should enter the letter midway between the two non-matching letters alphabetically (treating the alphabet as cyclical), the two answers affected becoming non-words. The letters entered may be up to six letters away from the non-matching letters in each case, e.g. X might represent W/Y, V/Z, U/A, T/B, S/C or R/D. The ten letters thus entered, read row by row from left to right and top to bottom of the diagram, form a female forename. No across or down word in the diagram is affected more than once, and the replaced letters may occur in either order.
